text:
emma: Heads-up — we got a thermal alert + short p95 spikes in eu2 at ~03:06 UTC, looks like warm-pool eviction thrash. Rack r33 flagged.

infra-bot: alert: rack=r33 thermal=80C, token_p95_up=26% (03:06:05 -> 03:06:40)

hugo: I pulled kv-metrics: tenant t-b14 shows bursty prefetch that drove evictions: evict_rate ~240/min sustained for ~90s. Co-tenants saw cold-kv miss rate jump x4.

kai: Any recent scheduler or cache rollouts in eu2?

emma: Cache GC micro-tweak rolled yesterday increased eviction aggressiveness a smidge to control tail mem. Seems to have reduced tail but increased sensitivity to pathological tenants.

lina: SLA impact? Numbers?

hugo: Quick check: ~95 chat requests breached 220ms p95 in the minute window, mostly on racks sharing r33's warm-pool. No pager but customer-visible.

emma: Short-term plan: 1) route t-b14 to a small fractional-dedicated slice 2) throttle its prefetch 3) temporarily relax eviction aggressiveness on shared pools in eu2.

hugo: Agreed. Router command I can run: `routerctl route set --tenant t-b14 --target fractional-dedicated --slice s-701 --grace 15s`

kai: Also suggest `schedulerctl set prefetch_penalty --pool shared --value 0.5` to blunt aggressive prefetchers.

lina: Can infra-bot post deltas in 15m for p95 and eviction rates? Want to validate the mitigation.

infra-bot: scheduled_check: will post p95 + kv_eviction deltas at +15m for rack=r33 tenant=t-b14

emma: Applying route change now.

infra-bot: action: route_change applied (tenant=t-b14 -> fractional-dedicated slice s-701), timestamp=3932101132

hugo: Note — fractional isolate increases GPU-hour burn slightly; estimate ~0.4 GPU-hours for the next 30m. Worth it to protect other tenants.

emma: I'll open follow-ups: (1) persist eviction-loop detector w/ thermal correlate (2) add thermal+eviction panel to ops dashboard (3) rollback plan for GC micro-tune if this recurs.

kai: Draft detector rule suggestion:
```
rule: eviction_thermal_quarantine
if kv_evictions_per_min > 200 and thermal_alert_within(5m)
then -> notify #eng-infra, assign-fractional, throttle-prefetch
```

lina: +1. If infra-bot confirms improvement we'll document the cost tradeoff and add an automatic playbook.

emma: Thanks team. Will wait for infra-bot and then post summary to #incidents. :thumbsup:
